method: Parses bounded robots.txt text entirely in the browser. Selects the longest case-insensitive User-Agent product-token match, using wildcard groups only when no specific group matches, and merges equal-specificity groups. Path matching percent-normalizes UTF-8 octets, supports * wildcards and terminal $, uses the longest rule, allows on equal-specificity conflicts, and implicitly allows /robots.txt. Absolute URLs are reduced locally to path and query; no network request is made.
